what: Proposed Step 1d.5 launches external Cursor/Codex reviewers but omits the dirty-tree sidecar checkpoint used after other external design boundaries
scenario_or_breakage: A brainstorm external can dirty the worktree before the free-form loop and Gate A; the run then continues against polluted files without the existing recovery prompt
suggested_fix: Mirror the Step 2a.3 sidecar scan and check-mid-run-dirty-tree recovery after brainstorm collection, with a brainstorm-specific STAGE and prompted sentinel

what: The --trivial plus --brainstorm Upgrade to --simple path is described as in-memory only while Step 0b still parses tier flags from unchanged ARGUMENTS
scenario_or_breakage: After the operator chooses Upgrade, Step 0b can still see --trivial and persist sketch_budget=0/review_budget=quick, contradicting the requested simple brainstorm flow
suggested_fix: Define an explicit tier override that Step 0b must honor when parsing ARGUMENTS, ignoring --trivial and writing SIMPLE/sketch_budget=2/review_budget=full after upgrade

what: The proposed Claude fallback asks subagents to write brainstorm output files while the role prompts say Do NOT modify files and existing fallback convention returns content to the parent
scenario_or_breakage: All-Claude or mixed fallback paths may leave expected brainstorm output files missing, causing synthesis to drop fallback ideas or treat the panel as failed
suggested_fix: Keep fallback agents read-only; have them return their brainstorm text, then have the parent orchestrator Write the returned text to the slot output files before synthesis

what: Plan adds test-brainstorm-prompts.sh but does not wire it into Makefile shards/docs or the Makefile-only agent-lint exclusions, and omits the write-run-params contract doc update
scenario_or_breakage: The new harness may never run under make lint or may be flagged as a dead script; scripts/write-run-params.md will still document only partition_requested after the schema adds brainstorm_requested
suggested_fix: Add a Makefile target, PHONY/shard entry, docs/linting row, agent-lint exclusion if needed, and update scripts/write-run-params.md alongside the schema change
